title: IBM shares jump 5%+ after a nearly six-month old video of President Trump praising CEO Arvind Krishna recirculated on X; IBM was already up ~40% over two weeks (Matthew Griffin/Bloomberg)
summary: Matthew Griffin / Bloomberg: IBM shares jump 5%+ after a nearly six-month old video of President Trump praising CEO Arvind Krishna recirculated on X; IBM was already up ~40% over two weeks — A nearly six-month old video of Donald Trump praising International Business Machines Corp.'s CEO sent the shares surging almost 9% on Monday …
